title: Japanese Takikomi Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious Japanese-inspired rice bowl dish, featuring mixed vegetables and savory takikomi rice.

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables (Takikomi Gohan)
ingredients.notes: any combination of carrots, peas, corn, and green beans

instructions: 1. Cook the Japanese mixed rice according to the package instructions.
2. Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
4. Add the cooked Japanese mixed rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
5. Season with soy sauce to taste.
6. Transfer the rice mixture to a serving bowl.
